Permission prompts in Chat View are now buttons on your PC, installed as v0.28.750.

Next: click Relaunch on the v0.28.750 card at the bottom left of the sidebar when it suits you.

  • When Claude or Codex asks permission, three buttons appear above the message box: Allow, Always allow, and Deny.

  • The buttons use the agent's own wording.

  • One click answers. The buttons then hide, so a double click cannot answer twice.

  • Keyboard shortcuts: Alt+Y allows, Alt+O always allows, Alt+D denies.

  • The shortcuts also appear in Ctrl+K and the F1 list.

  • Proof: a test runs the real app, opens a real permission menu, and clicks the button. The agent receives that answer exactly once. Screenshot attached.
